definitions: Succeeded in persuading or influencing (someone) to do something.
Bring about or give rise to (something).
Derive (a general principle) from particular facts or instances.
Initiate or speed up the birth of (a baby) by artificial means.
Produce (an electric current or magnetic field) by induction.
examples: The doctor induced her to take the medication.
They induced the general rule from specific observations.
A current is induced in the wire.
